newsitem.title: USA: U.S Northwest spot prods notionally flat on Monday.
newsitem.headline: U.S Northwest spot prods notionally flat on Monday.

text.p: Spot product prices in the U.S. Northwest stayed notionally flat Monday, with little direction from flat California markets.
Conventional-grade California gasoline idled at 60/61 cents on Monday, amid light trade and weak refinery margins.
Seattle conventional regular gasoline stayed notionally unchanged at 60/61 cents a gallon.
Seattle low sulphur diesel eased a cent to 74/75 cents and jet fuel remained 75/76 cents a gallon.
